newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - S-E-Banken 9-mo profit seen 4.17 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - S-E-Banken 9-mo profit seen 4.17 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish high street bank Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken is expected to post a profit after credit losses for the first nine months of 1996 of 4.17 billion crowns, according to a Reuters survey of 11 analysts' forecasts.
The 9-month forecast compares with the comparative 1995 profit of 1.40 billion crowns. S-E-Banken is due to announce its results on November 5.
The average forecast for the bank's credit losses was 1.05 billion crowns, compared with actual losses of 3.61 billion in the 1995 period.
Analysts expect the bank to show a full-year profit after credit losses of 5.42 billion crowns compared with 1995's 2.63 billion.
Sources: Enskilda, Morgan Stanley, SBC Warburg, Ohman, Penser FK, Fiba Nordic, Aragon, Handelsbanken Markets, Aros, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Carnegie.
